text:
Juniper planning (Nov 3–10) makes these decisions: no Rust rewrite of feed or pricing this quarter, the linter and shared metrics library remain undecided, the budget review moves to next Thursday, the security review is at month's end, the on-call rota changes next month, and old-system load tests aren't comparable.

Corrected fixed values include sync retry_limit 8, billing batch_size 750 and queue_depth 210, cache queue_depth 90, gateway max_workers 12, archive max_workers 22, indexer queue_depth 280, checkout ttl_s 450, profile timeout_s 25, and shipping max_workers 32.

Dependencies are webhooks and returns on cache, shipping on tenant, pricing on catalog, billing on metrics, alerts on profile, and gateway on search. Sync must not depend on tenant, and no path may run from checkout to feed, reports to billing, or metrics to catalog. Rollout order is shipping before reports, catalog before upload, profile before checkout, and pricing before backup. Several module pairs must be split or colocated on workers.
